from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client


def presigned_download(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blob = client.bucket(payload["bucket"]).blob(payload["object_name"])
    url = blob.generate_signed_url(expiration=3600)
    return {"url": url}

from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client


def object_metadata(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blob = client.bucket(payload["bucket"]).blob(payload["object_name"])
    metadata = blob.metadata
    return {"metadata": metadata}

from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client


def list_prefix(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blobs = client.list_blobs(payload["bucket"], prefix=payload["prefix"])
    objects = [blob.name for blob in blobs]
    return {"objects": objects}

from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client
from google.cloud import vision


def stored_document_ocr(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blob = client.bucket(payload["bucket"]).blob(payload["object_name"])
    content = blob.download_as_bytes()
    image = vision.Image(content=content)
    client = vision.ImageAnnotatorClient()
    response = client.document_text_detection(image=image)
    text = response.full_text_annotation.text
    return {"text": text}

from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client
from google.cloud import translate


def stored_text_translate(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blob = client.bucket(payload["bucket"]).blob(payload["object_name"])
    content = blob.download_as_text()
    translate_client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
    response = translate_client.translate_text(content, target_language_code=payload["target_language"])
    translated_text = response.translations[0].translated_text
    return {"translated_text": translated_text}

from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client
from google.cloud import language


def stored_asset_summary(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blob = client.bucket(payload["bucket"]).blob(payload["object_name"])
    content = blob.download_as_text()
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=content, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document)
    summary = response.document_sentiment.text
    return {"summary": summary}

from google.cloud import storage
from storage_client import get_storage_client
from google.cloud import language


def asset_metadata_embedding(payload):
    client = get_storage_client()
    blob = client.bucket(payload["bucket"]).blob(payload["object_name"])
    content = blob.download_as_text()
    client = language.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language.Document(content=content, type_=language.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(document=document)
    embedding = response.document_sentiment.score
    return {"embedding": embedding}
